## Workload

Lena Fischer graded 716 sets during 390 rostered hours. This equates to 1.8 sets per hour and provides a clear summary of the grading workload for the quarter. The volume completed was substantial, while the recorded hourly rate gives a consistent basis for reviewing the work undertaken.

## Quality

A sample of 65 sets was read again as part of the quality review. Agreement was 58.5 per cent. The review identified borderline background cases, and feedback was provided to support consistent grading in these circumstances.

The work was reviewed by Priya Anand. Overall, the review records both the scale of Lena Fischer’s workload and the outcome of the subsequent quality check.
